king.summary: Among them 83 and 84 would gladly have 124 as general in 158 again, but he cannot be persuaded.

chancellor.summary: A strong [war] council is held; they would gladly have 124 as general in 158; he could [...] become General of the Realm (Rigens Feltherre); something with Sparre and [quarters] in Holstein.
chancellor.en:
[On the audience with the Queen ... that] a strong [war] council is held, and they would gladly have 124 [...] general in
158. He could [...] become General of the Realm (Rigens Feltherre).

Then it went with 129 [...] with 123 ... from ... for Sparre ... that ... will [...] [quarters] in Holstein. Then ... for ...
who would [follow] ... [...] with him.

Holes as in the reading: [...] unread, [word] guess. 123, 124, 129, 158 are unidentified codes; the signs TT, Θ, ∞, Ψ,
Δ and Ш are unidentified.

hsehested.summary: Not solved: 30 numbers in a 3-32 set; no tested system gives Danish. The file shown is a failed trial, not a decryption.
